cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Yatra card rewarding flight and hotel bookings with accelerated travel points, surcharge waivers on tickets, milestone vouchers, and insurance benefits for frequent travelers.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: A complimentary air accidental cover of 50 lakhs with this credit card, and this cover is provided to Primary cardholders only.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, immediately report the incident to SBI Customer Care at 1800 1234, 1800 2100, or 1800 112211. For email support, contact customercare@sbi.co.in
